provenance.exposure: Exploratory chronological reanalysis: historical test seasons already inspected; strictly delayed online adaptation
provenance.coverage: Empirical prequential joint coverage; no finite-sample coverage guarantee under drift
provenance.efficiency: Mean log volume in 2H tangent coordinates. Posthoc exact empirical-coverage match via one global multiplicative rescaling per arm; never issued.
provenance.bootstrap: Point:2000 / volume:500 paired whole-storm percentile resamples. Posthoc scale refitted each resample; exploratory dependence limits remain.

config.models: separate horizon and ENU regressors; pooled storms, latest completed320; warm-up base fallback
config.inference: fixed-context query groups, cache fit; no query labels or inter-query preprocessing; numerical perturbation audit recorded
config.point_policy: unshrunk lambda=1 fixed a priori; no MAE gate or test tuning

calibration.method: delayed rolling rank, not PI+: historical score uses covariance frozen at its original issue
calibration.label_delay: full displayed trajectory horizon; equal issues use identical history
calibration.fixed_reference: geometry2018 / calibration2019; evaluated on same test cohort
calibration.coverage_match: posthoc global rescaling of issued q, diagnostic only; never deployed

config.comparison: Base / rolling C0(X+base) / rolling C1(X+base+4verifiedResiduals) / rolling ridge C1; same calibration per arm
config.evaluation: 2017 validation and2020–2024 test reported; no tuning. Online past test labels allowed after actual availability.
config.deviations_from_ECL: frozen pre2016 base; base already sees latest3 fixes; sparse stride2 cached origins; pooled storms; rank adaptation instead of PI+; no claim exact ECL replication
config.primary: joint coverage and mean log tangent volume; posthoc exactly matched empirical coverage; point MAE secondary
config.privacy: local checkpoint, offline hub and telemetry disabled; no remote inference or publishing
